sourceSentences: [0] Le principe du match-up est assez simple, vous devez jouer autour de son stun.
[0] Soyez donc patients ou essayez de lui faire claquer son stun dans votre passif, ce qui est assez difficile car elle a une range de auto-attack parmi les plus grandes.
[0] Au moment où Annie n'a plus de stun, c'est à votre tour de jouer. Elle perd une énorme partie de sa menace et vous pouvez donc plus facilement rentrer dans les trades.
[0] Je reste assez loin de la wave et m'approche seulement pour last hit au Q ou à Tornade. Et j'évite de me prendre un auto-Q auto-Q procré électrocute.
[0] Mon plan de jeu consiste à attendre que la wave soit de mon côté, que je sois au minima level 2 pour pouvoir trade et que Annie n'ait plus son stun.
[1] so so important not to stay too close to the minion wave. As you can see, if I stay outside, it's also easier to avoid enemy's poke.
[1] And if you have your stun ready, you can zone your enemy away from minions when your minions are low HP to deny last hits.
[1] It's also worth knowing that Annie has 625 range, so you can poke with your auto attacks as well

[1] And since your enemy can see your stacks of the stun, you can try this thing where you have three stacks, and then you just press E while going at your enemy. And at first they think you don't have the stun. And next time you do.
[1] And Tibbers also gets the shield, so this helps in pushing a bit to keep Tibbers alive for longer.
[2] Also remember guys, the range of Annie, the auto attack range of Annie is insane. It's one of the highest in the game.
[2] And remember, we want to have those flash ultimate engages with any support as well.
[2] So every single ability of Annie gives her a stack till four stacks. And once you have four stacks, the next ability is going to stun.
[2] You can just Q EW and it will stun the target.
[2] Every time you have ultimate, even if you don't have flash, you can look for ultimate play
[3] So you'll see that I always fight when I'm strong. When I have my ult, when I have my ignite, that's what I'm going to fight. Otherwise, I'm not going to fight.
[3] I don't have my ult right now, so I'm not going to play too aggro here.
